title: Automatic cleanup application consent
expect: Shared Material consent sheet: three lines explain action, cloud retention and limited accessibility use; experiment note; Not now and Go to settings.
Dismissal leaves cleanup off. Only Go to settings opens system settings. Real access is checked on return in production; Catalog supplies synthetic access.

The underlying Storage page keeps its three automatic options grouped, inset footnotes and standard section gaps. Dismissal preserves the scroll position; the final action and bottom padding can scroll fully into view.
At 412 dp, the English and Chinese sheet title, explanations and native actions wrap without orphaned words or characters; the underlying three automatic rows keep their parallel action phrases.
